tw-mi-eden-twp-noyes-gold-1935.st: The AP account: five men dug on the Eden Township farm near Scottville under a federal search warrant obtained at Grand Rapids, for money Fred Noyes of Ludington, a former owner who distrusted banks, said he buried there more than 30 years earlier from real-estate dealings; he said he left it in the ground ten years so his wife could not reach it, and had divorced two years before. The AP figure is $85,000 against $25,000 in the other telling.
src: Bay City Times, 7 Nov 1935, p. 1 (AP Ludington; Newspapers.com 1183313239)
